name: Somogymeggyes (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of green and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Somogymeggyes (a green shield with a yellow sheaf of grain and cherries) above a yellow scroll inscribed SOMOGYMEGGYES.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
